content.text:
I found 36 tracked top-level `*fn` functions. The clean answer is: build one modular Superfunctions admin shell, not 19 separate admin apps.

## Priority rubric

- **P0** — a commercial-quality product is impractical without human administration: persistent state, privileged/destructive actions, credentials, billing/security, workflow recovery, or non-developer authoring.
- **P1** — API/CLI can launch first, but an inspector/playground materially improves operations.
- **P2** — optional local workbench or artifact viewer.
- **None** — library/primitive; UI belongs to a consuming product or another Superfunction.

## Full inventory

`†` means the function exists in the current repository but was omitted from the supplied AGENTS overview.

| Priority | Function | Comparable product shape | Admin surface needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | `authfn` | Clerk, Auth0, Descope | Users, organizations, sessions, API keys, providers, MFA, impersonation, blocks/deletion, audit |
| P0 | `billfn` | Stripe Billing, Paddle, Dodo | Products/plans, customers, subscriptions, invoices, payments, credits, coupons, events, revenue |
| P0 | `catchfn`† | Jam, Bugasura, Sentry Feedback | Bug inbox, repro evidence, triage, assignment, issue sync; preferably a WatchFn module |
| P0 | `cifn`† | CircleCI, Buildkite, GitHub Actions | Pipelines, runs, jobs, logs, artifacts, runners, secrets, retry/cancel |
| P0 | `cmsfn`† | Sanity Studio, Contentful | Documents, media, preview, workflow, releases, collaboration, audit |
| P0 | `compfn`† | Vanta, Drata | Frameworks, controls, evidence, checks, exceptions, gaps, exports |
| P0 | `contentfn`† | Sanity Content Lake | Datasets, schemas, documents, imports/exports, webhooks; served through CmsFn Studio rather than another app |
| P0 | `datafn` | Supabase, Hasura, Firebase | Schema/table browser, records, query console, roles, migrations, events, performance |
| P0 | `filefn` | Cloudinary, UploadThing, S3 Console | File browser, uploads, transformations, access, quotas, retention, deletion/recovery |
| P0 | `flowfn` | Temporal, Inngest, Trigger.dev | Queues, workflows, schedules, run graph, replay/retry/cancel, DLQ |
| P0 | `hostfn` | Vercel, Railway, Render | Projects, deployments, build/runtime logs, domains, secrets, health, rollback |
| P0 | `mailfn` | Mailtrap, Postmark Inbound | Inboxes, messages/raw MIME, attachments, domains/routes, retention, credentials, webhooks |
| P0 | `plugfn` | Nango, Paragon, Pipedream Connect | Providers, OAuth connections, credentials, webhooks, sync/workflow runs, failures |
| P0 | `recfn`† | Recall.ai, Fireflies | Bots, meetings, recordings, transcripts, consent, retention, webhooks, failed captures |
| P0 | `searchfn` | Algolia, Elastic Cloud, Typesense | Collections, schema, documents, ingest jobs, relevance testing, analytics, keys, snapshots |
| P0 | `secfn` | Snyk, Doppler, Aikido | Secrets, policies, findings, access, rotations, approvals, security events |
| P0 | `sendfn` | Resend, Twilio, Novu | Messages/delivery logs, templates, domains, credentials, suppressions, webhooks |
| P0 | `userfn`† | Intercom, LaunchDarkly, Canny | Segments, flags, campaigns, surveys, feedback, roadmap, changelog, analytics |
| P0 | `watchfn` | Datadog, Sentry, New Relic | Metrics, traces, logs, errors, RUM, alerts, incidents, retention |
| P1 | `apifn`† | Postman, Stoplight | API catalog, spec diff, collections, environments, test reports |
| P1 | `botfn` | Botpress | Installations, credentials, event deliveries, conversations, jobs, failures |
| P1 | `browsefn` | Firecrawl, Tavily | Playground, crawl/retrieval jobs, results, provider credentials, usage |
| P1 | `cachefn` | Upstash, RedisInsight | Keys, TTL, hit ratio, hot keys, invalidation/flush, usage |
| P1 | `langfn`† | LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust | Traces, prompts, datasets, evaluations, token cost, feedback |
| P1 | `memoryfn`† | Mem0, Zep | Memory explorer, search, inspect/delete, retention, embeddings, statistics |
| P1 | `testfn` | BrowserStack, Sauce Labs | Runs, failures, flaky tests, visual diffs, trends, artifacts |
| P2 | `docsfn` | Mintlify, ReadMe, GitBook | Optional build/preview/search-index/analytics workbench; remain code-first |
| P2 | `probefn`† | Playwright UI/Trace Viewer, Percy | Local session, baseline, artifact and report viewer—not a control plane |
| None | `chartfn` | ECharts/Highcharts | Rendering library |
| None | `clifn`† | oclif/Commander | CLI primitives |
| None | `drawfn` | tldraw/Excalidraw | The canvas is its product UI; no admin |
| None | `extfn`† | Plasmo/WXT | UI belongs to each generated extension |
| None | `iconfn` | Iconify | Asset library |
| None | `logfn` | Pino/OpenTelemetry | Emit/transport only; WatchFn owns analysis UI |
| None | `mcpfn`† | MCPJam Inspector | SDK/conformance layer; external hosts own inspector UI |
| None | `uifn` | Ark UI, Radix, Storybook | Component system/workbench, not administration |

## What already exists

- **CiFn:** a real source-level dashboard with run list, run detail, logs, artifacts and login routes: [App.tsx](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/cifn/typescript/dashboard/src/App.tsx:11).
- **CmsFn:** a substantive Studio surface for datasets, document lists/editing and realtime updates: [app.tsx](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/cmsfn/studio/src/app.tsx:26).
- **AuthFn:** only framework-neutral admin APIs, currently limited to user listing/deletion—not a visual console: [index.ts](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/authfn/admin/src/index.ts:21).
- **WatchFn:** the dashboard is presently static placeholder data, including a literal chart placeholder: [page.tsx](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/watchfn/dashboard/src/app/page.tsx:11).
- **BillFn:** its intent explicitly calls for plans, payments, invoices, analytics, credits and coupons, but current `next` contains intent artifacts rather than implementation: [billfn-admin.intent.md](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/billfn/.conduct/intent/v0/billfn-admin.intent.md:2).
- **SearchFn:** its draft already specifies collections, schemas, ingestion status, errors and search analytics: [spec.md](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/searchfn/.conduct/spec.md:28).
- **UIFn:** `@uifn/sf` contains experimental customer-facing panels for AuthFn, PlugFn, FileFn and BillFn. These are tenant settings screens, not cross-tenant operator administration: [README.md](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/uifn/sf/README.md:13).
- **LogFn and McpFn:** their current boundaries deliberately assign UI elsewhere—WatchFn for logs and external inspectors/hosts for MCP: [LogFn spec](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/logfn/.conduct/spec.md:13), [McpFn README](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/mcpfn/README.md:15).
- **CatchFn:** currently delegates its dashboard to WatchFn queries; that should become a first-class WatchFn bug-triage module: [CatchFn spec](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/superfunctions/catchfn/.conduct/spec.md:26).

These are source findings only; I did not live-run the existing dashboards.

## Shared admin shell

Every P0/P1 module should reuse:

- AuthFn-backed tenant/project/environment switching, RBAC, MFA and support impersonation.
- Capability-based module registration and navigation.
- Resource tables, detail pages, saved filters, bulk operations and global search.
- One correlated events/runs/logs timeline with live tail, retry, replay and cancellation.
- Shared credential vault, redaction, rotation and webhook-delivery inspection.
- Immutable audit history, approvals, destructive-action confirmation, soft deletion and recovery.
- Usage, quota, cost, retention, backup/import/export and rate-limit controls.
- UIFn design tokens/components with accessible danger and permission-denied states.

Recommended build order: shell/AuthFn/audit → functional WatchFn backbone → PlugFn/SendFn/MailFn/BillFn/FileFn → DataFn/FlowFn/HostFn/SecFn/SearchFn → remaining vertical modules. Preserve CmsFn Studio as its dedicated authoring workspace and fold CiFn’s existing dashboard into the shared shell.
